newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrows.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed virtually unchanged at 476.25/476.75 per dollar Thursday, as increased competition between banks squeezed margins between bid and offer prices, traders said.
"The market saw a lot of (foreign currency) supply, and demand was occasional. So to compete we had to narrow the spread to just 0.50 bolivar per dollar," one trader said.
Trading was steady with banks preferring to gain a low margin on a higher trade in an effort to stay ahead of competitors, traders said.
The central bank entered the market to meet occasional demand but was relatively inactive, traders added.
